method: Median of 20 paired alternating shuffle seeds, GOMAXPROCS=1, count=1, 750ms, benchmem, CPU affinity 5. ns/op, B/op and allocs/op describe a four-edit cycle (two Go, two C); custom metrics describe one edit. Heap metrics omit C native allocations.

source_provenance.limits: Measurement containers do not expose Git metadata; raw source metadata is informational. Go and JavaScript timing overlapped default-off diagnostic-hook refinements. No engine policy changed. Exact output/work/reuse comparisons are recorded separately. The final primary Go trio ran after the instrument stopped changing. Optional frozen real-source follow-ups were not started because insufficient time remained.
source_provenance.location: Local Xeon Platinum 8481C VM, accepted timing CPU affinity 5; other lanes shared the host. Requested benchmark VM unavailable because cloud authentication lacked required scopes.
